title: Route preview
body: Explore an actual walking, cycling or driving route. Hazards, live closures and evacuation safety are not assessed.
locationPrivacy: Browser location is requested only when you choose it. Coordinates stay in this open session until you explicitly share them for a route. Map tiles may reveal the viewed area to swisstopo.
consent: I agree to send both precise route endpoints to FOSSGIS OSRM. The provider may log coordinates. Resilix does not save routes or coordinates to my chat history.
pickHint: Tap the map, or focus it and press Enter to choose its centre. Dragging only moves the map.
notAssessed: Preview only: no hazard or live-closure assessment. Follow local authorities; this is not an evacuation instruction.
consentRequired: Please approve coordinate sharing before calculating a route.
invalidCoordinates: Enter two valid, distinct coordinates within 250 km. Latitude must be between −85 and 85; longitude between −180 and 180.
routeBusy: The shared routing service is busy. Wait a moment and try again.
noRoute: No route was found for these points and travel mode.
routeUnavailable: The routing provider is unavailable. No substitute route has been drawn.
signInAgain: Please sign in again before requesting a route.
locationUnsupported: This browser cannot provide location. Enter coordinates manually.
locationDenied: Location permission was denied. You can change it in browser settings or enter coordinates manually.
locationUnavailable: Your device could not determine a location. Enter coordinates manually or try again.
locationTimeout: Location took too long. Try again or enter coordinates manually.
panHint: Drag or use arrow keys to move the map. Use plus and minus to zoom. When choosing a destination, Enter selects the map centre.
